title: Gratitude begins with mercy, not achievement
summary: This is not gratitude for being impressive. It is gratitude for being carried.
takeaway: Mercy is the atmosphere of real gratitude.
lifeApplication: Name one mercy you have been treating as ordinary.

source.shortMeaning: Gratitude grows when the heart admits both unworthiness and mercy.
source.lifeApplication: Let thankfulness soften you instead of making you self-satisfied.

evidence.coreClaim: Gratitude grows when the heart admits both unworthiness and mercy.
evidence.turn: Real gratitude does not inflate the self. It softens it.
evidence.practicalImplication: Name one mercy you have been treating as ordinary.
